name: SLOW DRAW: Dead West
summary:
The sun is setting. Three outlaws are standing between you and the exit.

In SLOW DRAW, time bends to your will. Move slow, think fast, and dodge bullets that would kill any other man. Snatch guns from the hands of your enemies and turn their weapons against them.

This is your town. Your rules. Your showdown.
— Dive into cinematic multi-floor takedowns
